notes.title: Bat Blast v2.0.0 pre-release update
notes.notes:
Changelog v2.0.0 (pre-release):

- Added a credits button to the main menu. You can now also skip the credits.
- Added a bug report button to the main menu.
- Added more bounce-shrooms to the Vacant Halls 2 bonus round.
- Added two fruit rechargers to the start of Vacant Gallery 2.
- Fixed an issue with the intermission shop not showing all bats.
- Fixed an issue with the back button in the Item Reference screen being finnicky with controllers.
- Fixed an issue with the spell shop incorrectly showing spells as being unavailable for purchase.
- Fixed an issue with the passive spell mouseover box showing a price.
- Fixed an issue with the Soul Seeker Spell lagging the game during the final fight.
- Fixed an issue with the game time counter UI appearing behind certain world details.
- Fixed an issue with the in-game menu title sometimes appearing behind certain world details.
- Fixed an issue with Vacant Gallery's 2 name appearing incorrectly.
- Fixed an issue with incorrect characters used in the description field for the Flowering Flamer.
- Improved the Demon Chakram spell.
- Lowered the star cost of the Soul Seeker spell.
- Tuning applied to the final fight.

notes.title: Beta Update 1.9.5
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with star counters not functioning correctly.
[*]Fixed an issue with Fruit Magnet sometimes turning coins into fruit.
[*]Fixed an issue with Rollers not being killable using Bat Spells whilst being within a certain range.
[*]Fixed an issue with some spells not breaking icicles.
[*]The Starlets talent has been reworked. Now produces orbiting projectiles.
[*]Fruits and treasures spawned by fruit baskets and treasure chests now turn into motes after 4 seconds.
[*]1UP pickups are now random spawns as opposed to being manually placed into levels.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 1.9.4 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added a ‘Replay Level’ button in the intermission.
[*]Added a shop to the intermission screen. Now you can purchase Bats, Lives, Spells and Talents between levels.
[*]Added Fruit Baskets. Breakable objects which provide many fruits when destroyed.
[*]Fruit now pops out of breakables and tumbles around.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 1.9.3 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the Best Time tooltip showing a price value.
[*]Fixed an issue with music not playing during Chapter 6.
[*]Fixed an issue with a wire in Chapter 6.
[*]Fixed an issue with Chapter 7 not unlocking properly.
[*]Increased the amount of gold rewarded for beating your previous time on a level. (Now 75g was 25g).
[*]Increased the initial bonus round time for the Mausoleum.
[*]The intermission will now tell you if the next level is a bonus level.
[*]Spell prices have been lowered considerably.
[*]Unaffordable spells are now greyed out in the selection menu.
[*]Your previous level completion time is now displayed in game.
[*]The level select menu has been refreshed and some things have moved around to make the menu more intuitive.
[*]Treasure chests have been improved.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 1.9.2 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added a new spell (Soul Seeker - a demonic projectile that hunts for nearby enemies and has a chance to replicate on contact with an enemy.)
[*]Enemy death sounds and object break sounds now only play if the player is within adequate range.
[*]Fixed a big with Summoners not flashing properly when hit.
[*]Fixed a minor bug in Shadowed Halls 5.
[*]Fixed a minor bug with enemies occasionally not being added to the codex.
[*]Fixed a minor bug with secrets occasionally not being recognised.
[*]Spell star costs have been tweaked again to provide more options.
[*]Chaospillar NPC art has been updated.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 1.9.1 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a rare bug where the intermission would fail to load the last levels save data.
[*]Fixed an issue where intermission music would still play even if music was disabled in settings.
[*]Fixed an issue where level select cards would not properly activate.
[*]Fixed an issue with particles showing when the screen has faded.
[*]Rechargers no longer contribute to Juice Up! pooling.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Update - 1.9.0
notes.notes:
Bat Blast! has been updated today. There are a ton of changes and additions:

[list]
[*]Added new achievements.
[*]Added custom cursor.
[*]Added a new enemy (Harbinger Mage).
[*]Added a new enemy (Sentinel).
[*]Added a new enemy (Wight).
[*]Added a new chapter (Ch. 7 - Frozen Ramparts). Music pending.
[*]Added a new spell (Demonic Chakram).
[*]Added a new feature (JUICE UP! Collecting 20 fruits causes you to JUICE UP granting you infinite, empowered blasts for the next 10 seconds).
[*]Added a new type of treasure called Diamond Gems. Diamond Gems grant you 50 gold but are very, very rare.
[*]Added music to the intermission screen.
[*]Added Treasure Chests. Chests have a small chance to spawn in the place of breakables and grant a varying amount of gold coins.
[*]Added new secret areas to the game. Each non-bonus level now has at least 1 secret area.
[*]Adjusted Arthur’s bat light to prevent colour blending that made him hard to see.
[*]Adjusted Spell Pricing. All spell costs have been increased.
[*]Adjusted Bat Pricing. All bat costs have been increased.
[*]Adjusted coin spawn chance (Nerfed - they now have a 2% chance to spawn down from 20%).
[*]Adjusted the Latent Mana (Nerfed - now has a 5% chance to grant you mana when hitting walls down from 40%).
[*]Adjusted the number of bonus coins earned for gaining level stars. Each star now earns you 5 coins. You can only earn gold for each star once per save file.
[*]Adjusted the Trailblazer talent (Has been tweaked so that the spawned fire trail no longer falls. Effects updated and burn increased to 1 second).
[*]Grails now have a 2% chance to spawn outside of bonus rounds.
[*]You can now type numbers in your save file name.
[*]Talents now cost gold to unlock them as well as having a star requirement.   
[*]Rollers now explode when hit by traps or spells.
[*]Fixed an edge-case bug with talent selection.
[*]Freakish Eyes can now only reproduce themselves up to ten times to prevent Freakish Eye swarms.
[*]Levels are now marked in the level select menu when you beat your best time.
[*]Secrets are now uniquely counted towards their related achievements.
[*]Misc. Hud improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Update - Jan 13th 2024
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed an edge case where the Chapter 6 levels would not correctly unlock.
[*]Fixed an issue with floating candles during the Chapter 6 intermission.
[*]Added a new bat called Bandit. Bandit has a 5% chance to collect gold coins when Bat Blasting into enemies and breakables.
[*]The in-game hud now displays your total gold instead of the total gold collected for that level.
[*]Music volume has been given a soft boost across the game. This can still be controlled via the slider in the Options menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Update - Dec 23rd 2023
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Saves are now stored in individual SteamID folders to prevent cross contamination when playing on a device with multiple Steam accounts.
[*]The resolution array in the main menu now updates correctly depending on the chosen aspect ratio. Resolution settings require further testing.
[*]Chapter 6 can be played all the way through. This chapter includes a boss fight with Fink!
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Update - 2nd December 2023
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a slider bug in c5_3
[*]NPC Damage grace has been increased further. You can now only take damage from an NPC every 1 second.
[*]Lowered the invulnerability delay Summoners gain after breaking their shield.
[*]Tweaked how NPC collisions work when Bat Blasting. All bats will now be able to damage multiple enemies per blast. When playing as Aiden, the blast will continue until bounces have been exauhsted. All bats barring Aiden will end a Bat Blast after hitting an enemy. Aiden gains bounces and velocity for each enemy killed in a single Bat Blast.
[*]Unity controller input is no longer normalized, which leads to smoother controller input. This requires further testing.
[*]NPCs can now be killed by Slime pits.
[*]Lowered enemy density in c4_3 and c4_4.
[*]Unity Player should no longer reject resolutions higher than 1920x1080.
[*]The game can now be maximised whilst in windowed mode.
[*]The fifth level of each floor will now unlock the next floor. This prevents you from having to complete the fifth level of a floor again if you quit during the bonus round.
[*]There is now a small delay before you can Bat Blast after being web-wrapped to prevent mis-input when clicking to escape.
[*]Spider Webbers now have a visible web that dangles to give players a heads-up that a webber is near. This web will break when hit.
[*]Spider Webbers will only attempt to web wrap the player twice. After two web-shots, Webbers will jump down in an attempt to hit the player.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Update - Nov 26th 23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]     Fixed an edge case where damage would ignore grace values and apply per-frame.
[*]     Seeking Sleepers now produce cute little Z’s when sleeping.
[*]     Added the Static Flamer - a new trap that spews eldritch fire. Found on floor 6.
[*]     Added the Freakish Eye - a new enemy that can multiply itself. Found on floor 6.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Update - Nov 19th 23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]     Fixed an issue with Homing Bones not conforming to gamesound mixer volume.
[*]     Fixed an issue with ground patroller collisions.
[*]     Fixed an issue with Ghost Bats not able to be killed by spells.
[*]     Fixed an issue with Gloom Wraiths not able to be killed by spells.
[*]     Fixed an issue with proximity based breakables.
[*]     You can now use RIGHT TRIGGER to Bat Blast and LEFT TRIGGER to Swoop.
[*]     You can now skip intro scenes immediately.
[*]     You can now choose between 16:9 and 16:10 aspect ratios in the options menu.
[*]     You can no longer be web wrapped whilst blasting.
[*]     You can no longer be harmed by slime whilst blasting.
[*]     Added some effects for interrupting bat blasts.
[*]     Lowered enemy density for Blighted Halls 3.
[*]     Increased the damage grace when interacting with slime.
[*]     Bats, Skeletons and Roller-type enemies can now be killed by spikes and traps.
[*]     Static Shooters can now be killed by bat blasts and spells.
[*]     Arcane Distortion 1 can now be played start to finish.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Update - Nov 18th 23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The tick noise when altering game volume will no longer play a million times per frame, preventing ear destruction.
[*] Fixed a prefs issue where GameSound wasn’t being properly modifed by settings.
[*] You can now interrupt a Bat Blast by Swooping mid-blast. This brings you to a steady stop and has been reflected in the tutorial. Dead Stop or the Detonate Talent can be used to stop a blast immediately.
[*] Gave the Gamepad UI Indicators coloured glyphs to represent XB controller input.
[*] Fixed an issue with inconsistent NPC collisions when playing as Aiden.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck on geometry in Shadowed Halls 4.
[/list]
[b]EXPERIMENTAL: [/b]Added Steam Deck detection which should appropriately set the game to 16:10.
[b]EXPERIMENTAL: [/b]Added higher resolution options above 1920x1080
[b]EXPERIMENTAL: [/b]NPCs can now be affected by traps like wallfangs, crush dangers and spikes.

notes.title: Beta Update - Nov 17th 23
notes.notes:
[b]Beta Update - Nov 17th 23[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the Tutorial would break if played before making a save game.
[*]Fixed an issue where the player couldn’t cast spells during the tutorial.
[*]Fixed an issue with wires appearing over the dialog box during the tutorial.
[*]Fixed an issue with super loud menu scrolling in the in-game menu when using a controller.
[*]Controller support in menus should now be dynamic. Using the controller should temporarily disable the mouse until it is used again and vice versa.
[/list]
